title: The probe size used for the entry price is not stored, and resume and re-arm use the current snipe amount, so a deliberate buy or a changed setting makes the monitor fire false stop-loss or trailing exits

evidence.note: armPositionMonitoring passes buyAmountNative (the actual buy amount; for a deliberate buy the operator amount, bot.ts:860) to startExitMonitor, which probes with parseEther(buyAmountNative) (:1866)
re-arm after a failed exit passes ctx.chain.snipeAmount too
resumeExitMonitor probes with parseEther(buyAmountNative) and compares against the stored entry price
exit_state stores entry_price but not the probe amount it was measured with (db.ts:505-513)
priceMultiple = current probe output / stored entry output
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Restart replaces the original buy cost with the current snipe amount

sibling_sites_checked: All probe sources: startExitMonitor via bot.ts:422 (buy amount) and :1483 (snipeAmount), resume via bot.ts:1948/:1955 (snipeAmount), re-arm via exitEngine.ts:731 (snipeAmount). For snipes the entry probe is the snipe amount at buy time, so only a changed <PREFIX>_SNIPE_AMOUNT between runs breaks them; for a deliberate buy any amount other than the snipe amount breaks the first resume or re-arm.
severity_rationale: S1. Proven by the code: the probe that produced the stored baseline is not the probe used afterwards. Plausible condition: a deliberate buy of 0.05 on a chain whose snipe amount is 0.01, then a restart or one failed exit. The output then falls to about a fifth, priceMultiple about 0.2, and stop-loss fires at once: an unwanted market sell with no output floor on the private leg (AUD-EXIT-001). The other direction (larger probe) activates trailing at once, disables stop-loss and fires every partial tier. The re-arm path makes this reachable without a restart, right after a failed anti-rug exit.
recommendation: Persist the probe definition with the entry price (or switch to a probe-independent price, card EXIT-02) and always re-quote with the persisted probe. Phase 24 together with RC-08.
